annotations.title: Check the status of a viewing request

description: Check whether a viewing request made with book_viewing has been confirmed. Requires the viewing_request_id and the status_token that book_viewing returned. The status_token IS the credential — there is no account, so treat it as a secret and do not share it or ask another user for one. Returns the current status (pending / confirmed / rejected / cancelled), the property id, when the request was made, and — once the agent has confirmed — the appointment date/time.

status_token.description: status_token returned by book_viewing — the credential
